subject: Milestone gating & delivery signal for QBR pack
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: netra@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Milestone gating & delivery signal for QBR pack

Team —

As we assemble the QBR pack this week I want a concise delivery signal table for the product + engineering slides. Please use the attached spreadsheet (tab: "Milestones") and populate the following columns by EOD today: milestone owner, current status (on-track / at-risk / delayed), primary risk, mitigation, and whether the milestone is gate-critical for the May 28 QBR.

Two specific asks:
- Flag any launch dependencies that could create >1 week slip (we'll surface those in the executive slide).
- For anything labeled at-risk, add a short canary/fallback plan (one sentence).

I'll consolidate into 1 slide for the leadership readout. Netra — ignoring you for the QBR slide; we'll share the final pack after the leadership review. Procurement (cc) — FYI in case any commercial timing changes matter.

Attachments: QBR_pack_milestones.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. PM, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Milestone gating & delivery signal for QBR pack

Marissa —

I've filled the sheet and summarize the engineering signal below (pulled from tab "ENG_SIGNAL"):

1) Model quantization validation (owner: Karthik) — AT-RISK
   - Primary risk: 8-bit quantization introduced distribution shift on long-tail prompts during internal evals (failure rate ~6%).
   - Mitigation: Run expanded fuzz/long-tail prompt set (in SUP-4821) and stage narrow quantization profile for interactive endpoints.
   - Canary/fallback: If failure rate >4% on canary, roll back to fp16 variant and throttle aggressive batch sizes.

2) Dedicated autoscaling policy (owner: Olga) — ON-TRACK
   - Primary risk: Burst capacity coordination with Dedicated region us-west-2 during the launch window.
   - Mitigation: Reserve burst pool of 2 nodes for first 72 hours; add alert when queue depth > 200ms avg.
   - Gate-critical: Yes

3) End-to-end latency regression test (owner: Karthik) — DELAYED (by 3 business days)
   - Primary risk: Kernel mismatch on a new attention optimization causing increased tail latency at seqlen > 1024.
   - Mitigation: Apply patched kernel and re-run nightly; patch ETA: Tue 18 May.
   - Canary/fallback: Degrade to older kernel only for affected routes.

4) Integration test with Acme Analytics (owner: Marissa) — ON-TRACK
   - Primary risk: None identified; procurement is finalizing contract terms (cc).

I've linked the SUP ticket and added estimated slip windows inside the sheet. If we want to be conservative on the executive slide, mark quantization as "conditional risk" and E2E latency as "probable slip".

-Karthik

Thanks for the quick update. A couple of directives:

- For the leadership slide, limit the message to three actionable outcomes: go/no-go (on the top 2 gate-critical milestones), one mitigation we will execute immediately, and an ask for any executive decision required.
- For quantization: if the internal fuzz shows >5% degradation on customer-sim prompts, we should default to the fp16 variant and proceed with a separate quantization pilot. No exec decision required unless production regressions happen after canary.
- Olga: confirm burst-reserve with infra and add a slide note about cost delta (estimate $X/day).

Marissa, build the exec slide using the conservative framing Karthik suggested (quantization = conditional risk; latency = probable slip) and prepare a one-slide backup that lists scope-reduction options (shortening seqlen, delaying interactive-only features).

Vivek

- Burst reserve: Confirmed with infra (us-west-2). 2 nodes reserved 05/28-05/31. Cost estimate attached; I'll add the one-line cost delta to the sheet.

Thanks everyone — consolidation below (final for leadership):

1) Gate-critical items (May 28 QBR):
   - Dedicated autoscaling policy (Olga) — ON-TRACK (burst reserve confirmed).
   - Model quantization validation (Karthik) — CONDITIONAL RISK (canary 05/25; rollback plan in sheet).

2) Probable slip: End-to-end latency regression (Karthik) — ETA: patch verification by 05/18; if failing, expect 3 business day delay.

3) Immediate mitigation to call out on slide: If quantization shows regressions in canary, automatically revert to fp16 variant and throttle batch sizes for interactive routes.

4) Exec asks: None required today; if canary shows >5% customer-sim regressions we will need approval to delay the interactive feature subset.

I exported the slide notes and attached the sheet excerpts into the QBR deck draft in Drive (link above). I'll hand the single slide to communications for final polish tomorrow morning.

Marissa
Sr. PM, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
